correctness.rationale: On a nonedge both triangle bounds hold automatically, and on an edge only 1 opposite 3 is forbidden. Universality realizes each admissible vector and homogeneity identifies it with one orbit over the named parameters. Arbitrarily many distinct points with the same vector can be added at mutual distance 1, so such a type is nonalgebraic. I independently generated rooted trees as multisets of smaller rooted branches, then deduplicated by taking the least all-root parenthesis code. This is complete because every rooted tree has a unique branch multiset and equality of one rooted code is equivalent to a rooted isomorphism. For each tree I enumerated occupied subsets, used bitmask searches for component sizes, and chose either uniform species on each component. The exact coefficients give unlabelled counts 1,1,1,2,3,6,11,23,47,106,235,551 and first collision orders 9,10,12 with exactly one fibre of size two each. Every reported witness edge set, degree multiset, occupancy and full coefficient list matches the independent result, including 3753, 8649, 55491 and the order-ten coefficient distinction 364 versus 363. The attribution repair does not alter the theorem, and the added specialization identities are immediate from the component weights.
residual_risks: Exhaustiveness is only through order twelve and only for the two-valued tree parameter metric.

value.rationale: Trees are a natural first reconstruction domain for a fixed graph target. The meaningful information loss is quantified at three natural gradings of the same type-counting invariant, and the two strict increases in the reconstruction range are not implied by the formal relation between the gradings or by the older Q-pair. The classified exact witnesses give a reusable baseline, especially the final pair which cannot be separated by retaining the entire one-point distance profile.
residual_risks: No inference about reconstruction on all orders, beyond the capped census, or for different metric embeddings.
